metaTitle: Custom Plastic Luggage ID Tags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom plastic luggage id tags for your team or event. Durable, lightweight, and easy to decorate. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Plastic luggage ID tags offer a lightweight, durable solution for identifying bags at a glance. Unlike fabric or metal tags, plastic resists moisture and scuffs, making them ideal for frequent travelers. With a clear strap for easy attachment, these tags are perfect for corporate travel gifts or team giveaways. Decorate them with your logo using full-color imprinting for a crisp, professional look that stands out on the baggage carousel.
heroAltText: Custom plastic luggage ID tags with clear strap and full-color imprint, perfect for corporate travel gifts.
